title: ailocalpack string table
description: The translations of a pack: key (from the recipe's extractor) → translated text. Stored gzip-compressed (strings/strings.json.gz). Holds no original text. Unknown properties are allowed.

strings.description: Key → translation. Keys are not empty.

context.description: Optional translator notes: key (present in strings) → note.

originals.description: Optional: key (present in strings) → hash of the original text the translation was made from (first 16 lowercase hex digits of the SHA-256 of its UTF-8 bytes), so a later revision can tell which strings a game update changed. Holds no original text.
